chapter_title: Chương 270: Chị Biên và em Đào lại gặp nhau

segments.title: Chương 270: Chị Biên và em Đào lại gặp nhau
segments.content:
Weigongcun, Minzu University of China.

By the time Tao Xue's military training ended, this year's Internet Conference was already over.

She was quite popular at school because she brought enough sunscreen and shared it with the girls in her class. Consequently, most of her female classmates had a good impression of her.

But there were always a few who scorned her "handouts" of sunscreen, or used her sunscreen without any gratitude. Behind her back, they gossiped that she acted like a rich young lady, wondering what was so great about having a couple of stinking coins to show off.

On the evening of the first Friday after school started, Tao Xue was dragged by her roommate to a social mixer with the guys from another dorm.

She felt bad turning them down, so she agreed.

They chose to have dinner at a restaurant outside the school. As freshmen who had just entered university, they were too shy to speak to the opposite sex. Only one or two extroverted ones were responsible for livening up the atmosphere.

At the dinner table, there was a clear divide, with boys and girls sitting on opposite sides.

At first, they could only talk about military training, but gradually the conversation turned to the local customs and traditions of their hometowns.

Tao Xue mentioned that her hometown was Longdu.

Gong Xu, the extroverted boy, immediately tried to get friendly with Tao Xue, chiming in, "Chen Guiliang is also from Longdu. Do you know him?"

Tao Xue said with a grin, "He's my senior from high school."

"Really?" Gong Xu was a little surprised.

Tao Xue nodded.

The female dorm leader, Xu Pinglan, put her arm around Tao Xue's shoulder and said, "Our dear Xiao Xue knows Chen Guiliang. She even talked to him on the phone a few days ago."

"Damn!"

"No way!"

Several of the boys exclaimed in amazement one after another.

Boys always have things they admire and like. Most boys are indifferent to celebrities, but they revere successful people in certain fields. Especially when this successful person is about their age.

Chen Guiliang was now an idol in the eyes of many boys.

These few boys were already chattering away.

"I only learned about Chen Guiliang from the newspaper after my gaokao. Back then, 'Xinwen Lianbo' reported on 'Legends of the Three Kingdoms.' Some newspapers in my area criticized him, while others praised him. So I looked up Chen Guiliang's information online and found out this guy is seriously awesome!"

"Haha, I started playing 'Legends of the Three Kingdoms' in my second year of high school. I even bought a physical set of cards."

"He's been even more awesome these past few days. Chen Guiliang went head-to-head with Li Yanhong at the Internet Conference. Judging by the content of their speeches, Li Yanhong's level is far worse than Chen Guiliang's."

"Li Yanhong is already old news. The internet now belongs to the younger generation!"

"Sigh, it's a pity we majored in ethnology."

"I applied for computer science but got transferred to ethnology..."

"Huh? Were you in the liberal arts or science stream in high school?"

"Science. My gaokao score was 50 points above the first-tier university cutoff. My classmates with slightly higher scores applied to USTB and BJTU. I didn't dare to apply to those schools, so I applied for computer science at Minzu University. In the end, I was transferred to the ethnology major."

This statement silenced everyone.

After a long while, Tao Xue said weakly, "I was just a few points over the first-tier cutoff."

Another girl said, "I was over ten points above the first-tier cutoff."

The boy had a pained expression. "Please don't say any more."

Tao Xue comforted him, "Actually, this is good too. Our school's ethnology program is a top-tier major, consistently ranked number one in the country. The computer science program, on the other hand, isn't even ranked. It's just that too many people applied, so you were transferred. The admissions officer probably saw your high score and specifically moved you to our ace major."

The boy waved his hand. "Let's not talk about it. Let's talk about Chen Guiliang instead. Sigh, I read his interview in the 'China Youth Daily' in high school. At that time, I thought to myself, I must major in computer science and also start an internet business during university!"

Tao Xue said, "Chen Guiliang isn't a computer science major either."

"He didn't study computer science?" the boy was stunned.

Everyone was floored.

He didn't even know what his idol majored in, yet he was talking about following his idol's footsteps to start a business in university.

The boy asked, "What's his major?"

Tao Xue reeled it off like she knew it by heart, "He hasn't chosen a major yet. The program he's in is very special. He can choose any course from any major. There are less than 150 students in his class, and 10 of them are provincial gaokao top scorers."

"Holy cow, 10 provincial top scorers. That's way too amazing!" Everyone exclaimed in awe.

Another boy said, "In ten years, I think Chen Guiliang's net worth will surpass Li Yanhong's. Xiaonei and Hainei are just too awesome. Take our class for example, school's only been in session for a week, and none of us have even bought computers yet, but half the class has already registered on Xiaonei."

Another boy said, "I don't think so. Baidu is super powerful right now. Who doesn't use Baidu when they go online? Baidu will become like Microsoft in the future. You can't be online without using Baidu, it's more powerful than any other company."

This point of view was very popular at the time.

Just as some gamers believed that "World of Warcraft" would never be shut down, many people also felt that Baidu could never decline.

Because people at that time couldn't imagine what the internet would be like without using a search engine.

As they chatted, the topic returned to the dispute between Chen Guiliang and Li Yanhong.

This was the hottest news at the moment!

Tao Xue listened happily to everyone's conversation. She liked it when her school senior was the hot topic of discussion among her classmates. It was often like this in high school too; there were always people in class talking about her senior.

After the mixer dinner ended, someone suggested going to sing at a KTV, but no one knew where to find one.

So, the group of boys and girls went to an internet cafe to surf the web together.

Tao Xue hadn't touched a computer in over half a month and had almost forgotten her "Lord of the World" account. After logging in, she didn't do her daily quests, nor could she be bothered to go kill monsters. She took her fishing rod, worth tens of thousands of yuan, and went fishing.

The extroverted boy named Gong Xu clearly had intentions of pursuing Tao Xue, turning his head to glance in her direction from time to time.

Seeing Tao Xue enter the game, Gong Xu looked as if he had seen a ghost. "You actually play this kind of online game? Shouldn't you be playing Audition Online?"

"I play it occasionally. Audition Online is so boring." Tao Xue rode her divine steed and charged towards the river.

Fortunately, Gong Xu didn't play "Lord of the World." He could only tell that Tao Xue's mount looked very cool, but he had no idea what kind of astronomical price this thing could sell for.

The other boys had already started shouting:

"Come on, let's play CS together!"

"Girls don't like shooters. Let's play Audition Online instead."

"I don't like Audition Online. How about KartRider?"

"That works too."

Tao Xue was dragged by them to play KartRider, but before playing the game, she wanted to add everyone as friends on Xiaonei. In reality, she was inducing those who didn't have an account yet to register for one quickly.

After playing for two or three hours, most of the students rushed back before the dorms closed, with only two guys planning to stay at the internet cafe all night.

After the girls returned to their dorm, they began to discuss which of the boys today was the most handsome.

Tao Xue thought to herself: None of them are as handsome as my school senior!

The next day, Tao Xue got up early in the morning and rushed to Peking University with great fanfare.

It was much closer for her to get to Peking University than it was for Bian Guanyue.

"Senior, I'm here to visit the Peking University campus!" Tao Xue only called after she arrived.

Chen Guiliang broke into a cold sweat because Bian Guanyue was also coming over to visit today.

Chen Guiliang said, "Come to my company. I have an appointment to discuss something."

It was Saturday, and many employees were on break, but a large number still insisted on being on duty.

The person Chen Guiliang was meeting was still from Google.

Kǎifù Lǐ didn't come this time. Another president, Zhou Shaoning, came instead.

"Hello, President Chen!" Zhou Shaoning's attitude was much more polite.

Chen Guiliang shook his hand warmly. "Hello, please have a seat."

Zhou Shaoning didn't directly discuss cooperation, but started with some small talk. "At the Internet Conference a few days ago, I had a meal with President Tao from Bailian Technology. We had a very pleasant chat and said we should invite you along next time."

Chen Guiliang asked, "You know President Tao?"

Zhou Shaoning said, "When President Tao was promoting the PHS at UTStarcom, I was the president of UTStarcom. Although we didn't know each other back then, we still worked at the same company. I happened to see him a few days ago, and he took the initiative to chat with me. We are now very good friends."

Chen Guiliang said with a smile, "A friend of President Tao's is a friend of mine."

The two of them chatted about Chinese online games, centering the conversation around Tao Chenggang.

They shot the breeze for a while.

Zhou Shaoning gradually got to the point. "Mr. Li was here two days ago. He may not have made it clear, but Google actually wants to have a deep collaboration with Bytedance."

"What kind of deep collaboration?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Zhou Shaoning said, "Google wants to participate in Bytedance's Series C financing, and the investment scale will be very large. We hope to acquire more than 8% of Bytedance's shares."

Chen Guiliang said, "I need to discuss this with the other investors first."

Zhou Shaoning said, "Investing in Bytedance is just the first step; what follows is the real cooperation. Google will provide Bytedance with technology, and at the same time, the two parties will jointly launch several new products. You, President Chen, can take the lead on these new products. Our only request is that Bytedance helps promote Google Search."

"May I ask what these new products are?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Zhou Shaoning said, "Something similar to the groups on Xiaonei and Hainei, but more like Baidu Tieba. When a user searches for a certain keyword, a relevant discussion forum is automatically generated. This requires Google's search technology because it's for the entire internet, not just within Xiaonei and Hainei. President Chen, once this product is launched, it will be extremely helpful to Xiaonei and Hainei!"

Chen Guiliang was a bit tempted by what he heard, but he voiced his doubt, "Both you and Kǎifù Lǐ are the top leaders of Google China. Why are the things you say different?"

Zhou Shaoning said, "This is the plan that was just approved after reporting to headquarters."

Chen Guiliang didn't believe such nonsense.

This pair, Kǎifù Lǐ and Zhou Shaoning, definitely had significant internal conflicts.

They were both headhunted by Google last year, and their external titles were identical: "Google Global Vice President and President of Greater China."

A dual-president system!

Kǎifù Lǐ was in charge of technology R&D, government relations, and brand public relations.

Zhou Shaoning was in charge of sales, channels, and cooperation negotiations.

However, Kǎifù Lǐ bypassed Zhou Shaoning to directly discuss cooperation with Chen Guiliang. It was tantamount to overstepping his authority and doing Zhou Shaoning's job.

Given Google China's dual-president situation, Chen Guiliang really didn't dare to rush into a partnership. Especially a deep collaboration.

Because Kǎifù Lǐ might not acknowledge the results of Zhou Shaoning's negotiations. Breaching the cooperation agreement was, of course, impossible, but a passive-aggressive attitude was a certainty. Once they entered a deep collaboration, the chances of getting screwed over were very high.

Chen Guiliang only remembered that Kǎifù Lǐ had been the president of Google China for many years, but he had hardly heard of Zhou Shaoning.

This person was most likely forced out by Kǎifù Lǐ!

It was impossible for him to have been sidelined and had his power usurped. Before UTStarcom even started selling the PHS, Zhou Shaoning was already the president of UTStarcom. For a figure of his level, if someone usurped his power, he would definitely resign immediately.

Chen Guiliang didn't refuse on the spot either. He said very tactfully, "Google is asking for too many shares. You'll have to talk to the investors first."

Zhou Shaoning said, "Only after we reach a preliminary cooperation agreement can I go talk to those investors. If Google invests in Bytedance, those investors will surely be willing, because it will be easier for them to cash out and exit in the future."

Chen Guiliang could only say, "Sorry, I'm not optimistic about this collaboration."

"Why?" Zhou Shaoning found it hard to understand; he thought it was a win-win situation.

Chen Guiliang answered bluntly and directly, "I'm not optimistic about Google China's dual-president system."

Zhou Shaoning was stunned.

But he still had a backup partner: Tianya Club.

Zhou Shaoning stood up and shook his hand. "President Chen, I hope we can cooperate next time."

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Like I said, a friend of President Tao's is a friend of mine. Let's have a drink together sometime."

"Sure, let's arrange it another day." Zhou Shaoning took his leave.

Since Chen Guiliang wouldn't cooperate, he would go talk to Tianya.

Tianya Club was about to be screwed over badly by Google!

The product Zhou Shaoning mentioned earlier was actually the future "Tianya Laiba." The two parties would also cooperate to launch "Tianya Wenda" (the predecessor of Google Answers).

These things were all negotiated by Zhou Shaoning with Tianya.

But just as "Tianya Laiba" was launched, Zhou Shaoning was forced to resign by Kǎifù Lǐ. Then, Google began to wrangle with Tianya, fighting for control over these products, and Google even tried to forcibly take 70% of the revenue.

In the end, they simply changed "Tianya Wenda" to Google Answers.

During the repeated wrangling between the two sides, the user experience of these two products became terrible. The boss of Tianya even complained that he felt like he was working for Google.

Chen Guiliang's instincts were very sharp; he subconsciously felt that something was wrong.

A dual-leadership system, how could any of them succeed?

But Kǎifù Lǐ and Zhou Shaoning were both heavyweight figures. When Google recruited them, neither was willing to be the subordinate, which ultimately led to the emergence of the dual-president system.

"Senior!"

As soon as Chen Guiliang walked out of the meeting room, he saw Tao Xue standing there with a beaming smile.

She was chatting and catching up with Xie Yang.

"You guys chat, I'm gonna dip," Xie Yang said.

Tao Xue waved with full energy, "Goodbye, Senior Xie!"

"Goodbye."

Tao Xue turned her head and asked Chen Guiliang, "Senior, are you this busy even on a Saturday?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Something just came up. But it's done now."

Tao Xue acted very understandingly. "Actually, you can keep working. I can wait until you get off work at noon to have lunch together. Don't let me hold up your important business."

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: What mood am I in to work today? Sigh, I knew it. Since you're both studying in the capital, you're bound to come over on weekends. You were bound to run into each other sooner or later.

Just then, Bian Guanyue arrived.

She was stunned for a moment when she saw Tao Xue, then she smiled and greeted her, "Tao Xue, hello, long time no see."

Tao Xue pouted. "Yeah, it has been a long time. I've been wanting to come and hang out with you, Senior Sister."

Chen Guiliang's mind wandered, as if his soul had already fled.
